featureSummary: Dealer Locator: Find Dealers CTA on homepage reaches the dealer locator page, which shows a top-cities list, and selecting a city reaches a results (DRP) page with more than one dealer.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Clicking "Find Dealers" from the homepage navigates to the dealer locator page
The dealer locator page shows a top-cities list with at least 5 cities
Selecting a city reaches a results page (DRP) showing more than one dealer, each with name, address, and a CTA

commentScenarios.summary: Does the sort/filter option on the dealer results page actually reorder the results, or just visually open?
commentScenarios.status: COVERED — both sort and filter genuinely change the results, not just visually open
commentScenarios.notes: Sort by Name: first result changed MIDAS -> 4 WHEEL PARTS, URL changed to ?sort=name. Filters panel opens (Services/Networks facets); selecting the "Air Conditioning" service filter and applying it reduced results from 566 to 5 dealers — a genuine filter, not a cosmetic-only control.

scenarios.name: Homepage loads cleanly with no blocking errors
scenarios.expected: Homepage loads, title reflects Michelin USA, no navigation errors
scenarios.actual: Title 'Explore Michelin Tires, Products & More | Michelin USA' loaded, consent banner dismissed successfully

scenarios.name: Find Dealers link navigates from homepage to dealer locator page
steps: Highlight and screenshot the "Find Dealers" link
scenarios.expected: Browser navigates to the dealer locator page

scenarios.name: Console/network health check immediately after AC-1 navigation
steps: Inspect captured console errors and network failures right after landing on the dealer locator page
scenarios.expected: No first-party errors that break the visible dealer-locator flow
scenarios.actual: Only third-party/analytics noise observed (CSP-blocked data: audio/script, a 400 on an analytics-looking endpoint, 404s on third-party dealer-logo images) — none affect the tested flow. Logged as observations, not bugs.

scenarios.name: Top-cities list shows at least 5 cities on the dealer locator page
steps: Census anchors on the dealer locator page
scenarios.actual: Exactly 5 auto dealer-locator city links found: Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, New-York — meets "at least 5" with no headroom

scenarios.name: Top-cities list boundary: exact minimum count, no duplicate/broken entries
steps: Cross-check city link hrefs against expected slugs (atlanta, chicago, dallas, los-angeles, new-york)
scenarios.expected: Each city link has a distinct, well-formed href with no duplicates
scenarios.actual: All 5 hrefs are distinct and correctly slugged under /auto/dealer-locator/{city}

scenarios.name: Selecting Atlanta reaches a results page with more than one dealer card (name, address, CTA)
steps: Census dealer cards on the results page
Highlight and screenshot the first card
scenarios.expected: Results page loads with multiple dealer cards, each showing name, address, and a CTA
scenarios.actual: Navigated to /auto/dealer-locator/atlanta; multiple .dl__card-dealer cards found, each with a title (e.g. MIDAS), address, and a "Contact dealer" CTA

scenarios.name: Dealer card CTA is a real, clickable contact action
steps: Locate the "Contact dealer" CTA on the first card
Confirm it is a real interactive button element in the card
scenarios.expected: CTA is a functioning, non-decorative control
scenarios.actual: "Contact dealer" is a real <button class="ds__btn"> nested inside the dealer card contact-cta wrapper

scenarios.name: Sort by Name genuinely reorders dealer results (not just visually opens)
steps: Record first card title before sort (MIDAS)
Record first card title after sort
scenarios.expected: First result changes and reflects real reordering by name
scenarios.actual: First card changed from MIDAS to 4 WHEEL PARTS; URL also changed to ?sort=name — genuine reorder, not a cosmetic-only interaction

scenarios.name: Filters control on dealer results page opens a usable panel
scenarios.expected: A visible filter panel/dialog opens with filter controls
scenarios.actual: A slide-in panel opens showing "Services" and "Networks" filter facets and a "See results" action. Note: an initial DOM-diff-based check on this run produced a false-positive miss (wrong class selector) before the screenshot proved the panel does open; corrected after visual verification.

scenarios.name: Applying a Services filter genuinely narrows dealer results
scenarios.expected: Applying a filter reduces/changes the dealer result set, not just visually toggles
scenarios.actual: Dealer count dropped from 566 to 5 after applying the "Air Conditioning" service filter — a genuine, functioning filter

scenarios.name: Sort state boundary: URL persistence and back-button behaviour
steps: Open a fresh tab directly on .../atlanta?sort=name
Confirm first card is 4 WHEEL PARTS
Navigate back on the original tab (sorted -> unsorted)
Confirm first card reverts to MIDAS
scenarios.expected: Sort state survives a copy-URL-to-fresh-tab test, and the back button restores the previous (unsorted) state
scenarios.actual: Fresh tab on ?sort=name correctly showed 4 WHEEL PARTS first; back button correctly restored the unsorted list with MIDAS first

scenarios.name: TC-AN1 — analytics signal fires on interaction
steps: Snapshot window.dataLayer length and start capturing analytics-looking requests before first interaction
Compare dataLayer length and captured requests
scenarios.expected: At least one analytics request or dataLayer push captured after interaction
scenarios.actual: window.dataLayer grew from 15 to 31 entries; 52 analytics-looking network requests captured

analytics.evidence: dataLayer length 15 -> 31; 52 analytics-looking requests captured (gtm/analytics/collect endpoints)

observations: Console: CSP blocks of an injected data: audio/script and a 400 on an analytics-looking endpoint (dctityd.michelinman.com/status-log) observed on every page — appears environmental/third-party, does not affect tested flows.

Network: 404s on third-party dealer-logo CDN images (cdn-prod-nam.yepgarage.info/.../logo-bmw.png, logo-audi.png) on the results page — broken third-party brand logos, cosmetic only, does not block AC-1/2/3 or sort/filter functionality.

Self-correction note: an initial DOM-diff heuristic (className regex) reported the Filters control as non-functional (candidate MAJOR bug). Before finalizing, the required screenshot evidence showed the panel actually opens correctly, and a follow-up check confirmed applying a filter genuinely narrows results (566 -> 5). The false-positive was retracted per the Bug Verification Protocol — flagged here for transparency, not filed as a bug.

Scope note: this run was explicitly focused on AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 and the sort/filter comment scenario per the request. Full regression census (pagination, map, geolocation, boundary checklist beyond sort/filter/URL) was intentionally not exhaustive and is flagged for a follow-up full run.
Automation gap: both the sort control and the filter control have zero automated coverage in this suite despite both working correctly — recommended as a top priority for the next automation pass.
